messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT firing: inference-serving/high_latency x120 (threshold 250ms)
ops-bot: PagerDuty incident created: PD-4892 (multiple alerts)
sara: seeing ~120 pages from PD in last 10m, this is noisy. Anyone oncall for SRE? @alex?
alex: on it. can you paste the alert body?
sara: pasted below -- looks like all replicas of the same model are creating individual alerts.
sara: ```json
{
  "alertname": "inference_high_latency",
  "model": "gpt-lite-8k",
  "instance": "gpu-3",
  "cluster": "us-west-2",
  "latency_ms": 480
}
```
mike: hmm we used to group by alertname+model, but I think alertmanager group_by got reverted during the alertmanager config rollout last week. That would cause one page per instance.
carla: confirm: PD integration is creating a new incident for each alertgroup? or dedupe key missing?
alex: PD will create incidents per unique group key from Alertmanager (group_key). If group_by includes instance then PD will get many incidents. Looks like group_by currently includes instance. Need to change to only ["alertname","model","cluster"].
sara: short term: can we silence or rate-limit to stop the pages while we fix grouping? customers are being affected but paging noise is drowning out actual operator signals.
mike: yes. I'm going to add an Alertmanager silence for alertname=inference_high_latency + cluster=us-west-2 but scope to 15m so we have breathing room.
mike: running: 
```bash
amtool silence add "inference-high-latency-spike" \\n  --match "alertname=inference_high_latency" --match "cluster=us-west-2" \\n  --starts "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" --ends "$(date -u -d '+15 min' +%FT%TZ)"
```
sara: :thumbsup: Thanks. That should stop PD duplicate pages. Alex, can you push a hotfix to Alertmanager config?
alex: will do. Plan: patch config to set group_by: ["alertname","model","cluster"] + update PD dedup label to use {{ .GroupKey }}. I'll make the change in the cluster-config repo and apply to alertmanager-ops via k8s rollout.
alex: draft patch: ```yaml
route:
  group_by: ["alertname","model","cluster"]
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 5m
  repeat_interval: 3h
```
carla: remember we have other alerts that intentionally group by instance (node-exporter volume alerts). Make sure change is scoped to the prometheus namespace that handles inference alerts or use route matchers.
alex: good call. I'll add a child route: ```yaml
route:
  routes:
    - matchers: ["namespace=ml-serving"]
      group_by: ["alertname","model","cluster"]
    - matchers: ["namespace=infra"]
      group_by: ["alertname","instance"]
```
sara: while alex applies, can we add a Grafana panel to track per-model alert rates and pages? PD is reporting 120 pages but we need trend per model to tune thresholds.
mike: I'll spin up a quick dashboard in the ops grafana: dashboard: Ops / Inference / Alerts - shows alerts/min by model, top instances, and PD incidents. ETA 30m.
sara: customer impact? any reports?
alex: no direct customer-facing errors surfaced in support yet. Model latencies spiked briefly due to a degraded autoscaler, but majority recovered. We'll verify log traces for requests >500ms.
carla: I'm filing an incident summary ticket: INC-2543 with initial root cause hypothesis: alertmanager routing reverted -> alerts grouped by instance -> PD per-instance pages -> operator overload. Assign to alex/mike for followup.
carla: INC-2543 created: https://tickets.internal/INC-2543
sara: good. Postmortem needs: timeline, root cause, config diff, followups (grouping rules, alert thresholds, dashboard, PD rate-limit).
alex: rolled out config to alertmanager-ops. Applying now: `kubectl apply -f alertmanager-inference-route.yaml -n monitoring`
alex: deploy bot: :white_check_mark: alertmanager-ops deployment rolled out (3/3).
mike: silence expired but since grouping fixed we should not get 120 PD pages. Monitoring PD -> still seeing a couple but much reduced.
sara: noted. For long term: propose these actions —
- [ ] Add automated unit test for alertmanager routes in ci (deny accidental instance grouping for ml-serving)
- [ ] Add PD dedupe config to integration so PD incidents include group_key in title
- [ ] Tweak inference_high_latency threshold per model (gpt-lite vs gpt-std)
- [ ] Create dashboard and alert-rate playbook (oncall runbook)
- [ ] Postmortem writeup and customer comms if we find impact

carla: I'll own the playbook and ticket triage. Alex and Mike to own config + dashboard. Sara, you'll write immediate incident summary for comms?
sara: yep will post summary in #incidents and ping support if anything to notify. Draft: "No customer-facing errors observed; transient latency spike due to autoscaler; alertmanager routing misconfig caused PD noise; grouping fixed; follow-ups created (INC-2543)."
carla: handoff: sara -> carla for overnight followup at 23:00 PT. Sara, leave any outstanding links and runbook notes here.
sara: leaving links: alerts: https://prometheus.internal/alerts?filter=inference_high_latency
dashboard (temp): https://grafana.ops/d/abcd1234/inference-alerts
ticket: https://tickets.internal/INC-2543
sara: OK handing off. If pages come back, page carla on PD-4892 and escalate to SRE oncall.
carla: ack. Closing active noise. Will verify in morning and follow up on the checklist. Thanks everyone :heart:
